summary: GateConfig: min_clean_sessions=60, min_in_sample_trades=300, min_oos_sessions=20, min_oos_trades=100 as floors; lowering raises ValueError.

gate.run_intraday_replication_protocol: session-boundary 70/30 IS/OOS + 3 walk-forward folds on the K5 engine (real vectorbt), statutory costs, benchmarks; unclean/thin history -> insufficient_history, engine not run.

ReplicationGate: minute evaluations take an intraday branch (_intraday_refusal): replay label, bar_end clock, reconciled tw_price_1m snapshot hash, frequency equals declared strategy frequency, no waived/quarantined/isolated flags, no unclean sessions, counts >= thresholds; otherwise refused/insufficient. Daily path unchanged.
Trades are counted as closed round trips. 70/30 with a 20-OOS-session floor implies >= 66 clean sessions in practice (documented in GATE_CONTRACT §3c).
